text.KJV NEH 12:32: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
text.KJV NEH 12:34: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

A.name: Ezra
A.line: son of Seraiah (EZR 7:1), scribe skilled in the Law (EZR 7:6)
A.notes: as "priest" would be a descendant of Aaron
family: son-of seraiah-2 (Seraiah, the chief priest (2KI 25:18) who was killed by the king of B)
priest-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
scribe-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
descendant-of hilkiah-2 (Hilkiah, the high priest of King Josiah's reign (2KI 22:4, 2CH 34:9))

B.name: Ezra
B.line: Priest with trumpet in the wall-dedication procession under Nehemiah, distinct from the scribe leading it

why: עֶזְרָא appears among the dedication procession’s listed participants (vv.32–34), matching B’s stated setting and role. These verses supply no father or office distinguishing him from A, so this identification remains tentative.
